title: My Members » Search Members » Members Table
text:
## My Members » Search Members » Members Table
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000103850

## Search Results Members Table
This is the search results table of all the members in the website. The table will vary its content based on the search parameters used in the search filters.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12158549777/original/t4X6TenxXFNebSuNDs1XbhnR3zd7eNKs1w.png?1742313661 | alt: ]

## 1. Status
This section explains the different account statuses available in the platform, defining what each status represents and how it affects a member's access and functionality. It also includes the profile image if the listing is set as an individual or the company logo if the listing is set to company.
For a detailed list of the different account statuses and how to edit them, refer to the following article: Account Status
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12158550252/original/O-aHp2gHyU8E0idfgVu4JuX3yJw_pYIMNQ.png?1742314028 | alt: ]

## 2. Contact Information
This section provides details about the member's contact information, including their name, listing type, email, phone number, location, and social media accounts.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12158550262/original/vE9rv6Oocc7bTcAUlhWsXgGIw6RU6bQ96g.png?1742314042 | alt: ]

## Name (Individual) / Company Name (Company)
Displays the full name if the member is an individual. If the listing is set as a company, this field will show the registered company name.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12159608693/original/x9ELpKQ96fCDEXdXLu3NBBsWKMnzaTkORQ.png?1744131559 | alt: ]

## Listing Type
Indicates whether the listing is an individual profile or a company account.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12159608727/original/YuWrGMPVDQe81KpxBJjbeddL63huqw5-SA.png?1744131598 | alt: ]

## Email Address
Shows the registered email address associated with the member.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12159608747/original/l32CUCs5jkZNhhTsdTvV0jtkHJej9eKp3A.png?1744131619 | alt: ]

## Company or Member Alternative Name
For individual listings, this field displays the company name if provided. For company listings, it shows the primary contact person’s name.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12159608791/original/FQInn2R_2qTOA_O_8K2MksrmlANjpRGX4g.png?1744131657 | alt: ]

## Phone Number
Displays the primary phone number associated with the member.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12159608629/original/XBOD3rwZPU8C0gOMBuebWSILqNEAdjJybA.png?1744131506 | alt: ]

## Geocoding Information
Includes geographic coordinates associated with the member’s location, helping to identify their approximate position on a map.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12159608613/original/F4hd9FTfDaNsMWt7YcNxgFWbmg-1rmGCbg.png?1744131480 | alt: ]

## Social Media Accounts
Lists links to the member’s social media profiles, such as Facebook, LinkedIn, Twitter, or other platforms.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12159608576/original/6hk-KQUHmFXeG2URnuFMzisO6rOqPoAVyg.png?1744131456 | alt: ]

## 3. Actions Menu
The actions menu provides quick access to essential account management options for each member. These actions allow for profile updates, account maintenance, and communication.
The following article describes each option available in this menu: My Members » Search Members » Actions Dropdown
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12181027823/original/tSIQETOdpDMYouITAJVjOxbD_SCg23pwUQ.png?1782400340 | alt: ]

## 4. Profile Views
If the Profile Statistics Add-On and setting are enabled, the amount of views the profile has received, will be displayed here. This setting is setup per membership plan.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12158550316/original/qWe31JZYOC6BGMv5IqjYLgNhdSkuNM86bA.png?1742314086 | alt: ]

## 5. Membership
The results table displays members who match the applied search criteria. Each row represents a member and contains key details.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12159608203/original/c5NXyXBa5-MI7DeevqFHP0Pv_os2_H-DEw.png?1744131164 | alt: ]
Member ID : A unique identification number assigned to each member.
Membership Plan : Displays the membership plan associated with the member.
Join Date : Indicates when the member joined the platform.
Last Login : Shows the most recent login date of the member.
Category : Displays the primary category under which the member is classified.
Parent Account ID : If the Multi-Member Manager add-on is activated on the site, this field shows the ID of the parent account.

## 6. Revenue
This column is a financial overview of the member. It displays information like:
The total of any past due payments.
Credits available .
The revenue generated by the member.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12161153851/original/MGiSlTzYgUE_0Qj257chIKW4flTZDWRG6g.png?1747001899 | alt: ]
